scores.notes: Peter leaps from the boat's gunwale clutching his cloak while the beloved disciple points toward Jesus standing by a charcoal fire on the right shore; no lettering, edges fully painted, anatomy sound.
Hezekiah in blue-and-gold robe with open hands before carved temple doors, priests at left and bronze basins on oxen across the court; no lettering or edge issues found.
Folded newspaper at lower right carries rows of pseudo-text marks; Holmes at the door has a gaunt, swept-back face strongly resembling Peter Cushing's screen Holmes; white deckled margins (accepted).
Peter mid-dive off the bow, cloak flying, young disciple pointing, Jesus on the right shore beside a small fire with village hills beyond; no faults seen.
Radiance floods the gate with merchants opening chests and jars, no figure for Wisdom; but a framed wall plaque on the right building (approx. x1080,y370) bears faint rows of pseudo-letters.
Levite holding a knife over the uncut, cloaked body by lamplight, donkey with bundles seen through the doorway; restrained, no gore, no lettering, edges painted.
Priest kneels at the bronze altar over ashes, but Moses at right grips two separate staffs (a crook and a straight rod), and a whole intact white dove lies on the ash rather than crop and feathers.
Disciples bail with bowls and haul ropes in a storm-tossed boat, Jesus asleep on a cushion in the stern, lamp on the mast and other boats nearby; hands and faces read correctly.

Five men in the vault (two at left, one peeking at right, plus Watson and Holmes) where only four are cast; Watson kneels on top of the crate he should be hiding behind, revolver beside his knee; white margins (accepted).

The Caterpillar is drawn as a blue, old-man-faced creature wearing a bowler hat, shirt and waistcoat, dress the text never gives it (and the blue colouring echoes the animated film); Alice and mushroom otherwise fit.
Saul clutches his head under a cloud-like burst of radiance with companions and donkeys recoiling, Damascus domes on the left horizon; white paper shows at the bottom-left edge (accepted).
David by the brook with crook-staff, sling and bag, Goliath in scale armour with shield bearer and soldiers beyond; sky vignettes into white paper (accepted), no other faults.

The Cheshire Cat floats with its whole striped body though the text says only the head appeared; the flamingo lying behind Alice has three legs; washed-out paper at top corners (accepted). Card pips on the arch soldiers are suit symbols, not writing.
Four Roman soldiers crouch casting dice over garments on a rock, Jesus on the cross above with a blank titulus, no gore; sky left as blank paper (accepted).

Boaz holds two separate staffs, one in each hand; a prominent bearded man in green sits among the Bethlehem women at left though no such man is cast; the boy stands beside rather than between Ruth and Boaz.
Peter steps from the boat onto the waves toward Jesus, who stands on the water holding a glowing lantern, disciples watching under a moonlit storm sky; no faults found.

Moses with staff leads families carrying children between towering walls of water, with the pillar of fire glowing far behind; viewed from the front rather than behind, but the subject, action and place are shown.
Egyptian chariots and horsemen surge along the seabed between water walls under dark clouds; horses and riders are sound, no lettering, edges painted.
Moses raises his rod at the cliff as water gushes, Aaron in breastplate beside him, people and livestock crowd to drink; white paper vignette at the edges (accepted).

The staging is reversed: Jesus stands inside the tomb next to the rolled stone while the bandaged Lazarus is already outside among the crowd and Martha, so Lazarus is not emerging from the tomb; white corners (accepted).
The White Rabbit's scroll at the witness box is covered in lines of scribbled pseudo-text; otherwise the King, Queen, Alice, animal jury with slates and card courtiers fit the scene.
The Mock Turtle (weeping, calf ears) treads on Alice's toe while the Gryphon circles on the shingle; the sky fades into bare paper at top left (accepted), no other faults.
Holmes examines the battered felt hat with a lens while Watson watches by the fire; papers pinned to the wall and shelf at upper right carry rows of pseudo-writing.
The foreground stone markers are carved with Greek-like pseudo-inscriptions (e.g. 'AGPANI'); a small blank white square sits in the extreme top-right corner.

The right seraph holds tongs with a burning coal (the later verse 6 moment), and both seraphim show bare feet with no wings covering them, the left one covering its face with its hands; no figure drawn for God, only fire.
Wooden crates at right and centre carry stencilled lettering ('ST', 'TE' and lines of text); Watson with revolver on the crate, Holmes with a lantern and two men beyond otherwise fit.
